notes.title: Bug Fix for Korean, Trad. Chinese, and Spanish Languages Implementation Update
notes.content:
Dear Tsugunohi fans,

We have discovered an issue in the June 15th language update where the 3 newly added languages were not implemented properly and could not be switched to in-game. 
We are terribly sorry for any inconveniences this may have caused, especially to the users who were trying to access the 3 languages. 
Today, July 6th, we have fixed this issue. First, select the desired language in the Steam Properties menu, then update the game!
